name: Gibran Alfi Ananta
summary: I'm always curious about new technologies that make things simpler and more efficient. Beyond technology, I'm also interested in understanding global events and macroeconomic factors influence market movments.
about: I'm an Information Systems graduate with an interest in exploring technology and understanding how it can be used to solve everyday problems. My professional focus is in web development, particularly fullstack development with a stronger interest in backend development. I'm also interested in prompt engineering and exploring how AI can support more efficient ways of working. Beyond my professional interests, I'm curious about data analytics, investment, and global economic developments. I enjoy understanding how data provides insights and how macroeconomic factors influence financial markets.
